name: @crossborder/plugin-ai-listing
description: Capture products from Alibaba.com and other platforms, process them with AI (translation, pricing, compliance), review in a visual editor, then publish to target platforms in one click. Includes capture history, rule management, publish tracking and AI-assisted editing.
description.zh-CN: 从 Alibaba.com 等平台抓取商品,经 AI 信息处理(翻译、定价、合规),预览编辑人工确认后一键发布到目标平台。含抓取历史、规则管理、发布记录与 AI 员工协同编辑。
